scenes.line1: Which .NET is right for your app?
scenes.say: Which dot net is right for your app? Do you know the key differences between .NET and .NET Framework?
Dot net, formerly dot net core, runs on Windows, Linux, and Mac. It's open-source, with unified versioning. Dot net framework is Windows-only and considered legacy.

scenes.label: LTS
scenes.sub: Long-Term Support releases get 3+ years of updates.
scenes.say: Dot net offers long-term support releases, called LTS. These get at least three years of updates, giving you stability and security.
For example, dot net six is an LTS release, supported until November twenty twenty-four. Dot net framework four point eight is only supported on Windows.

scenes.question: Why pick an LTS release for production?
scenes.right: LTS releases offer stability and long-term security updates.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Why choose an LTS release for production? It's not about new features—it's for stability and long-term security updates.
